scenario_name: Control Plane Protection against ICMP Flooding
base_template: Write a critical system alert. The Edge Router {{router_name}} is at {{cpu_load}}% CPU load due to a massive ICMP flood targeting {{mgmt_ip}}. Describe the performance degradation of the network.
expected_solution: Create an Extended ACL to match ICMP traffic and apply it to the 'control-plane' to rate-limit the traffic.
